_readme: Vague / conversational recall cases for the Haiku-interface experiment (experiment/haiku-interface). Written 2026-11-25 against a copy of the live store taken 2026-11-25 22:41 (out/haiku-exp/shadow-20261125-224152.db, not committed). 'context' holds the last turns a reader may use; the current hook sees only 'prompt' (it has topic carry-over in a live session, which this eval cannot give it). Expected ids were picked by reading the store, by one judge (the experimenting agent): treat as indicative.

cases.prompt: what did we say about swapping the embedder earlier today
remind me of the improvements we talked about earlier today

context.text: ok back to statekeeper. the per-prompt block was injecting junk, board asks and stuff
Right, that was the noise in the per-prompt injection; I looked at what it showed for PR-number prompts.

cases.prompt: what was the order John wanted for the receipting stuff again
what did we land on for the sweeper and receipt dates
how did he want the linear cleanup reported, one summary or per item?

context.text: the linear reorg is going to touch a ton of tickets

cases.prompt: what was that settings change John made so edits stop getting blocked
can I just retry the failed azure job myself?
what did we decide on the receipted gifts checkbox
remind me what we decided about the slack duplicate window
which ones were the worst offenders again?

context.text: we were looking at how noisy the datadog alerts channel is
Yes, most of the epd-alerts-datadog messages are noise; a few monitors make up most of it.

cases.prompt: and the csv one, what happened with that?

context.text: go over the receipt date decisions John made today
The sweeper may set a missing Receipt Date from the most recent receipt; it never sends a new one.
